header: ◆ PROJECT MARKER (project colour; SITE 00 red default)
shell.type: Martian Mono host (uppercase law); project faces only inside authority media

tabs.job: Where are we? What needs me? What happens next?
sections: NEEDS YOU (0–n items, each one action)
NEXT (next family + what it will require + estimated cost)
PROJECT SUMMARY (scope · phase · progress · price · production expenses)
FAMILY ROADMAP (families with status, approval, est./actual cost, dependency)

tabs.job: Human conversation that is not a structured review action

items: PRODUCTION CREDITS (only if funding_mode is client-funded)

not_in_client_app: margins / labor cost / SITE 00 internal API spend

project_type_adaptation.CLIENT_PROJECT: Full room; reviews by client; cost center per funding mode.
project_type_adaptation.FOUNDER_PROJECT: Same room viewed by founder (VIEW AS CLIENT); REVIEWS shows founder approvals; cost center shows SITE00_INCLUDED spend.
project_type_adaptation.PERSONAL_PROJECT: JURNL case: no client review user; REVIEWS = founder self-approval; INBOX hidden (no counterpart); cost center shows founder ledger.
project_type_adaptation.rule: One component tree; project type toggles sections via capabilities — no duplicated product.

live_and_tree_addendum.sixth_tab: NO. SITE and TREE live inside existing tabs.
live_and_tree_addendum.PROJECT: Journey + WORKING TREE. Tree has its own deep-linkable child route /app/:slug/project/tree (?node=<id>) because it is a full-screen place and the target of VIEW IN TREE.
live_and_tree_addendum.REVIEWS: Family review gains a DESIGN | LIVE segmented control. LIVE becomes the primary authority once the family reached live implementation.
live_and_tree_addendum.LIVE VIEWER: Full-screen client viewport overlay route /app/:slug/live/:nodeId (deep link from tree, review, notification). Not a tab.
live_and_tree_addendum.FINAL REVIEW: A review of kind FINAL at /app/:slug/reviews/:reviewId with segments SITE · TREE · SUMMARY; surfaced on HOME as NEEDS YOU when ready.
live_and_tree_addendum.why: Keeps the locked 5-tab nav; matches the starting hypothesis; tree is understanding (PROJECT), live is judging (REVIEWS).
